definitions.explanation: A criminal charge for an unsuccessful attempt to kill someone. Frequently encountered in news reports about criminal cases.

examples.japanese: {殺人未遂|さつじんみすい}の{容疑|ようぎ}で{逮捕|たいほ}された。
examples.english: He was arrested on suspicion of attempted murder.

examples.japanese: {殺人未遂|さつじんみすい}{罪|ざい}で{起訴|きそ}された{男|おとこ}は{容疑|ようぎ}を{否認|ひにん}している。
examples.english: The man indicted for attempted murder is denying the charges.

examples.japanese: {被害者|ひがいしゃ}が{命|いのち}を{取|と}り{留|と}めたため、{容疑|ようぎ}は{殺人|さつじん}から{殺人未遂|さつじんみすい}に{切|き}り{替|か}わった。
examples.english: Because the victim survived, the charge was changed from murder to attempted murder.

notes:
USAGE:
A legal term commonly appearing in crime news. Composed of {殺人|さつじん} (murder) + {未遂|みすい} (attempt, failure to complete). The ～{未遂|みすい} suffix can attach to other crimes: {強盗未遂|ごうとうみすい} (attempted robbery), {放火未遂|ほうかみすい} (attempted arson).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {殺人未遂|さつじんみすい}の{容疑|ようぎ} (suspicion of attempted murder)
- {殺人未遂|さつじんみすい}{罪|ざい} (the crime of attempted murder)
- {殺人未遂|さつじんみすい}で{逮捕|たいほ} (arrest for attempted murder)

RELATED WORDS:
- {殺人|さつじん}: murder, homicide
- {未遂|みすい}: attempted (but not completed)
- {既遂|きすい}: completed/consummated (crime)
